content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. When powered on, the screen blinks. After removing the cover, I noticed some small scrapes on the board. Is it possible to determine the cause of this issue?

The user is looking for possible explanations or solutions regarding the source of this malfunction. No responses were provided by other community members, leaving the user without guidance or resolution.
